ns2:group.ns2:description:
Your blood should have more in common with ketchup than just color, says chemical engineer Sean Farrington. Demonstrating the flow of everyday products like shampoo, peanut butter and ketchup, he makes the case for expanding the use of blood viscosity as a medical diagnostic, much like blood pressure. Learn more about the little-known field of rheology and how it could save lives — if taken seriously. (Recorded at TEDxWilmington on April 26, 2025)

ns2:group.ns2:description: Chatbots might help you get work done faster — but at what cost? When we outsource our reasoning to artificial intelligence, we reduce ourselves to "middle managers for our own thoughts," says AI and design researcher Advait Sarkar. He examines the cognitive trade-offs of using AI at work and introduces a different kind of tool: one that encourages critical thinking, nudges reflection and actually helps you get smarter.

ns2:group.ns2:title: 刘震云×罗永浩！有些玩笑含着泪也要开完 ｜ Liu Zhenyun: Some Jokes to Cry For
ns2:group.ns2:description:
时隔四年，刘震云老师带着他的新书《咸的玩笑》和我们进行了一次长谈。这一次故事又发生在家乡河南延津，又是一群失意的不知道找谁诉说的人们，又是一些生活中无可奈何的小事，最后不动声色地卷起狂风暴雨。几十年的文学创作让他成为了一个人类观察家，别人看到的是如常的生活，他说这里边全是哲学问题；别人听到的是玩笑，他却察觉了玩笑的味道，有些玩笑是咸的，因为开玩笑的人含着眼泪。那些平凡的日子，遗落了一些珍贵的东西，刘震云将它们捡起，用文字串了起来。他带着我们读懂了那些埋藏在冰冷世界里的异彩和辛酸。 《罗永浩的十字路口》第十七期，我们邀请了作家刘震云，谈谈他的新作，谈谈他的往事，谈谈那些即便流着泪也要开完的玩笑。
Four years later, Liu Zhenyun returns for a long and intimate conversation — inspired by his new book 咸的玩笑. Once again, the stories take us back to his hometown — Yanjin, Henan. Once again, we meet ordinary people who don’t know where to take their grievances, small helpless moments of daily life, and storms that gather quietly, without warning. Decades of writing have shaped him into a careful observer of humanity. Where others see ordinary life, he sees philosophy.
